best: Blocks carry clear descriptive titles and the simple circuits (3V3 buck, antenna pi match, back-to-back protection FETs, four-switch stage) are drawn as recognisable textbook paths with values visible.
worst: Overlapping reference/value text at the gauge and charger ICs (R105/C105, TH101, R116 over SCL label, R445/R446 near BQ25756) hurts legibility

Charger controller is wired to its support parts by long right-angle wires that wander around the IC, while the power stage and gate drive are tied only by labels, so the buck-boost does not read as one circuit
Poor use of space: dense tiny clusters at the top of each sheet with large empty regions below, and stray parts (Q409, R432, TP412, connector pins) floating alone tied only by labels
